notes: Snap to Edge now offers the four corners (Top + Right, Top + Left, Bottom + Right, Bottom + Left) as single choices, not just one edge at a time.
Fixed the Snap to Edge dropdown rendering its selected value cut off and unreadable — a forced height was too short for how the dropdown actually draws itself.

The Corner radius slider (and every other slider in Panel Settings) now actually shows its filled position — previously the fill was wired to a value nothing ever set, so every slider looked stuck at empty regardless of its real value.
Corner radius’s slider now matches OG’s own volume/brightness slider — same thin line, same small dot.
"Edit Panel" now sized and weighted like OG’s own clock — OG’s biggest, most prominent piece of text — instead of this window’s generic heading style.
